statement: A thin ring of radius 0.14 m carries a uniformly distributed charge of +3.1 microcoulombs. A point charge of -2.0 nC sits on the ring's axis, 0.21 m from the ring's center. Use k = 8.988e9 N m^2/C^2. Find the magnitude of the electrostatic force on the point charge.
find: Magnitude of the force on the point charge.
